Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3\text{i}-9\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -3\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3\text{i}-9\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{0} \\ \overset{―}{-3\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3\text{i}-9\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3\text{i}-9\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3\text{i}\,\overset{―}{k}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain that 

$$
3\text{i}\,\overset{―}{k}=3\text{i}-9\,⟹\,\overset{―}{k}=\frac{3\text{i}-9}{3\text{i}}=1+3\text{i}.
$$

 

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{1+3\text{i}}=1-3\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Im}(k)=-3.$
